test_overview:
All 5 test steps passed (40/40). The evaluation verified Rate Cards inline edit/delete with undo and confirmed changes immediately affect Calculator quote results.

Step 1 (test_edit_affects_exact_match): Filtered Admin > Rate Cards by toSuburb=Riverside showing exactly 2 rows ($120.00, $115.00). Inline-edited 115.00->105.00 and saved; row displayed $105.00 and Undo showed (1). Calculator quote (B2C, Warehouse Central origin, Easton/Riverside, Dining Table x1, services 0) returned Exact Match with Total $105.00 and rate/m3 $105.00.

Step 2 (test_undo_edit): Clicked Undo once; Riverside row restored to $115.00, Undo (0) disabled. Re-ran quote: Exact Match, Total $115.00, rate $115.00.

Step 3 (test_delete_affects_city_match): Cleared persisted suburb filter, deleted Lakeside row ($130.00); row removed from table. City Match quote (suburb blank, 3-Seater Sofa x1) returned "City Match", "2 suburbs available for this city.", Total $144.00 (120.00 x 1.20), rate $120.00.

Step 4 (test_undo_delete): Clicked Undo once; Lakeside row ($130.00) reappeared. Re-ran City Match quote: "3 suburbs available for this city.", Total $156.00 (130.00 x 1.20), rate $130.00.

Step 5 (test_reset_clears_undo): Inline-edited a row (115->116) and saved; Undo (1) shown. Executed Reset All Data (accepted confirm + alert). Rate Cards dataset empty ("No rate cards match the current filters", 0 rows) and Undo cleared ("Undo (0)", disabled).

All non-fatal verifications (undo counter display, matched rate display) also passed.
